facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 17 March 2008 a near hit was recorded on SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
